lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form localized grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher pixel intensity on the superior side and shadow on the inferior side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distribution of approximately 12 discrete high-luminance circular blobs scattered across the lateral silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-luminance circular spots on the distal portions of both the upper and lower lobes of the caudal fin.
